title: DDE acquisition activity
description:
Narrows cdifProvActivity for DDE acquisition. Everything an acquisition activity may carry -- schema:instrument, schema:participant, schema:startTime, schema:endTime, schema:agent and the rest -- is inherited from cdifProvActivity rather than restated here; this block adds only what is DDE-specific.
What it adds: at least one instrument typed with a DDE acquisition category. cdifProvActivity already requires each described-in-place instrument to carry the Wikidata measuring-instrument term, so a DDE instrument's schema:additionalType carries both, for example [{"@id": "dde:sensorType"}, {"@id": "https://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q3099911"}].
What it does not add: a required data collector. The DDE XSD has no collector element -- MD_Imagery is sensor, platform, equipment, signalGenerator, wavelength and processingLevel, all optional -- so a DataCollector participant is a convention, not an obligation. DataCollectorRole below documents the shape without requiring it, and participants of any other shape cdifProvActivity allows remain valid.

schema:instrument.description: At least one instrument carries a DDE acquisition category. "contains" rather than "items" on purpose: an acquisition may legitimately list instruments that are not DDE-categorised alongside the ones that are, and constraining every item would reject them.

schema:participant.description: Unconstrained beyond cdifProvActivity. DataCollectorRole records the shape DDE imagery conventionally uses for the collecting agent; it is referenced here only so the definition travels with the block, and imposes nothing.

DdeTypedInstrument.description: An instrument whose schema:additionalType names a DDE acquisition category. The four categories are listed as separate anyOf branches rather than one enum so each can be extended independently later, and so a validation failure names which category was expected.

DataCollectorRole.description: The conventional shape for the collecting agent: a schema:Role with roleName DataCollector wrapping a Person or an Organization. Documented, not required -- see the block description.
